content.text: In Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation crippled traditional commerce infrastructure, COREMERCH arose as a sovereign commerce solution for digital creators in restricted regions. The problem? Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy are unavailable or severely restricted, locking out creators who rely on crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s for their digital products. This infrastructure guide addresses the challenge head-on, providing a [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-what-2|GitHub Pages]].io/store/blog/nonsense-guide-getting-paid-usdt-digital-work-full-2|no-nonsense]] approach to building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages that accepts payments without platform dependencies.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution that combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to establish a payment and delivery pipeline that's not beholden to traditional platforms. With Stack 02, creators can deploy their digital stores in 48 hours, configuring SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability and end-to-end testing before handoff. This infrastructure is designed for sovereignty, giving creators complete ownership and control over their commerce operations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before building your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting and a NOWPayments account for on-chain crypto payment verification. The Sovereign Blueprint, available for $47, provides detailed documentation for all 5 stacks, including Stack 01 and Stack 02, as well as the NOWPayments integration guide and scaling playbook. This blueprint will help you prepare your infrastructure for deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by deploying Stack 01, combining GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. Once you've set up your payment pipeline, configure your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments offers 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC or buyer account requirements.

COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a comprehensive solution for digital creators in restricted regions, combining Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments for a payment and delivery pipeline that's not beholden to traditional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question you'll ask is: 'How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?' The answer is simple: you can't. Traditional platforms come with fees, restrictions, and dependencies. Instead, build your store on Cloudflare Pages using COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification. This infrastructure is designed for sovereignty, giving you complete ownership and control over your commerce operations.
Test a real mainnet transaction before you promote — finding a configuration error with your own crypto costs less than finding it with a buyer's.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these concrete steps: (1) sign up for a GitHub account for hosting; (2) deploy Stack 01 in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint; (3) configure your payment pipeline using NOWPayments; (4) set up your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2; (5) deploy your digital store to Cloudflare Pages; and (6) process your first transaction using NOWPayments' dashboard.

Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages using COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification.
